product.name: Monoprice Universal VESA Adapter Plate for TV Wall Mounts 50x50mm to 400x200mm
product.description: So you just got a new, larger screen TV and it won't fit on your existing wall mount? No problem! As long as the mount can handle the weight of the new display, you can use this Wall Mount Bracket Universal Adapter from Monoprice™ to adapt your existing mount to the VESA size needed for your new TV.This adapter bracket includes holes for VESA® 50x50, 75x75, 100x100, 200x100, 200x200, and 400x200, allowing you to adapt from one size to another.Support Files: User's Manual (Oct 30, 2017)Dimensions Diagram (Oct 30, 2017)Monoprice™ and all Monoprice logos are trademarks of Monoprice Inc. VESA® is a trademark owned by the Video Electronics Standards Association (VESA®) in the United States and other countries.
